summary: Turkmenistan presents two high-relevance mixed conservation and agriculture commitments focused on land rehabilitation: comprehensive rehabilitation of 70,000 hectares of irrigated land (KROZ) and meliorative improvement of 170,000 hectares of land (MUZ). The first target is equivalent to approximately 700 km², or 1.5% of the country's mapped 46,537 km² agricultural area; the second equals about 1,700 km², or 3.7% of that area. Relative to Turkmenistan's total land area, they represent approximately 0.15% and 0.36%, respectively. These pledges emphasize ecosystem restoration and agricultural-land improvement, although no implementation dates, baselines, additionality, or indication of overlap between the programmes are stated.
